text:
You're blocking your own genius.

It's 2 a.m. You're building. The work is sharp but feels small. A ceiling you can't break through.

You have s*x. You have love. Maybe romance. But they're separated. Three things running on different tracks.

S*x alone is a hurricane. Destructive. Add love: directed and balanced. Add romance: the wall between you and genius shatters.

Integrate all three as one force. That's when your work becomes unstoppable.

Start today. Not eventually.
caption:
Most men separate s*x, love, and romance. The ones who don't integrate all three build unstoppable work.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
